newsitem.title: USA: US East Coast heat oil stocks up 1.5 mln bbl - EIA.
newsitem.headline: US East Coast heat oil stocks up 1.5 mln bbl - EIA.

text.p: Heating oil stocks on the U.S. East Coast rose 1.5 million barrels last week to 24.8 million barrels but were 42 percent lower than a year ago, an Energy Information Administration analyst said Wednesday.
Total East Coast distillate stocks -- heating oil and diesel -- rose 2.2 million barrels to 39.8 million barrels for the week ending Oct 18 versus 59.5 million barrels a year ago.
Although inventories remained thin, total U.S. distillate production stayed at a strong 3.6 million barrels per day for the second week in a row and only the third time since 1989.

Gulf Coast refiners boosted production of distillates by 45,000 bpd to 1.79 million bpd, increasing Gulf Coast stocks by 300,000 bpd to 30.0 million barrels and helping to keep total U.S. production at 3.64 million bpd.
"Stocks in PADD III (Gulf Coast) appear poised for movement toward PADD I (East Coast) markets as they are at their highest level in more than a year," EIA said in its weekly distillate report.
Total U.S. stocks of distillates fell 100,000 barrels to 111.3 million barrels in the week ending Oct 18 from the previous week.
EIA said refiners ran 14.1 million bpd of crude oil, using close to 95 percent of operating capacity, and lowered output of gasoline by about 30,000 bpd to stress distillate output.
